notes.title: New minor update: Designer 15.0.2
notes.content:
We have just released a new minor version (15.0.2).
Look at the detailled release notes for more information.

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] [3D View/OpenGL] Remove the wireframe effect applied on the selected Mesh
[*] [3D View] Allow using the 'F' key to focus on a selected mesh when the Scene Browser has focus
[*] [3DView] Render not refreshed when changing normal map format
[*] [BakersCLI] Add option to control surface cache size
[*] [BakersCLI] Rename "use_cache" option to "keep_meshes_in_cache"
[*] [Bakers] Display Bake CLI command line in debug 
[*] [Console] Log the 3D scene loaded in the 3D View and the 3D renderer
[*] [UI] Refresh icon for 3D scenes in Library
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] [3D View] Crash when assigning a material node to a multi-material scene
[*] [3D View] Graph created from texture inputs is always viewed in 3D View regardless of preferences
[*] [3D View] Incorrect usage in a 'Viewed in 3D View' badge tooltip in a specific case
[*] [3D View] Lots of USD errors when overriding specific scenes
[*] [3D View] Shadow artefacts when using displacement on a flat Scene in the rasterizer
[*] [3D View] Some specific scenes are not visible when using OpenGL renderer
[*] [3D View] The Dialog used to "Select the destination Substance Graph" always have the "Pending" graph icon
[*] [3D View] The viewport contextual menu is not displayed for specific scenes
[*] [3D View] 'Viewed in 3D View' badges are not cleared when switching scenes in a specific case
[*] [3D View] Washed out color in 3D View when using Adobe ACE color management
[*] [3D View][Linux] Several scenes render black in the OpenGL renderer
[*] [3D View][Scene Browser] Arrow keys move the selection at the root
[*] [BakerCLI] Can't override some parameters
[*] [Bakers] Artifacts in dilation when using normal bakers with antialiasing
[*] [Bakers] Baking process abruptly stopped in CLI while baking a high amount of UDIMs at 4K
[*] [Bakers] Crash when pushing baker down in baker list in specific case
[*] [Bakers] Format selection switches from .surface to .dds
[*] [Bakers] Freeze while baking high amount of UDIMs at 4K
[*] [Bakers][macOS] Crash when baking Texture transfer with antialising
[*] [Content] Point list: Points are not in the correct order when data texture is non-square
[*] [Content] View color palette: Internal nodes are computed at too high resolutions
[*] [Data] Crash when renaming output to fix ghost output in instance
[*] [Engine] Distance: input mask luminance is altered
[*] [FxMap] $tiling has no effect if the FX-Map is inside a subgraph
[*] [Graph] Fuzzy search returns irrelevant results
[*] [Python Editor] Loaded scripts are not reopened across sessions
[/list]

notes.title: Designer 15.0.1 is now available
notes.content:
Just one week after the 15.0.0, we publish a first bugfix version (15.0.1).
Look at the detailled release notes for more information.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] [3D View] Allow to texture USD Meshes that have displayColor and no Material bindings
[*] [3D View] Do not automatically create one material per mesh that does not have a material binding
[*] [3D View] Rename "Converged pixel samples" to "Samples"
[*] [3D View] Rename the "UV Scale Enabled" parameter to "Enable Physical Size from Graph"
[*] [3D View] Scale down the displacement intensity according to the 'Tiling' parameter
[*] [3D View/OpenGL/Iray] Add a message in the viewport when the default environment is disabled
[*] [Bakers] Use icons for buttons to reorder lines in the Bakers render list
[*] [Preferences] Add an option to define the default 3D View renderer
[*] [Properties] Make 'Reset to default' use the authored default values if any
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] [3D View] Artefacts on specific scene when rendered with OpenGL
[*] [3D View] Default environment is not disabled when loading a USD 3D scene resource that contains one
[*] [3D View] Displaying the viewport contextual menu takes several seconds in large scenes
[*] [3D View] 'Emissive intensity' is 0 when overriding non-USD materials using 'Emissive color' only
[*] [3D View] Red and Blue channels are swapped in 8-bit texture used as environment
[*] [3D View] RMB drag&drop does not work consistently because of right click register
[*] [3D View] 'Show only' on subset hides its parent mesh
[*] [3D View] The default Scenes loaded from a files appears with a wrong base color
[*] [3D View] 'UV Scale' property is reset when switching from OpenGL to another renderer and back
[*] [3D View][Iray] Renders are often blurry and pixelated
[*] [Bakers] Artifacts when using diffusion on an AMD GPU
[*] [Bakers] Baking fails with some scenes for UV sets other than 0
[*] [Bakers] 'Transferred texture': The 'UV Set' list does not take 'Use low as high poly' option into account
[*] [Bakers] UV tiles selection is always reset to 'All'
[*] [Graph] Crash when deleting a node in context
[*] [Mac OS][3D View] Incorrect render resolution on mac displays
[*] [Parameters] Modified parameters are not stylized on first display
[*] [UX] Disabled items in dropdown menu are invisible
[/list]

notes.title: Designer 15.0.0 has been released
notes.content: [p]This update brings a brand new 3d renderer, with rasterizer and pathtracer modes, plus a native support of [url="https://openusd.org/release/index.html"]USD[/url] to allow you to edit and export scenes without any loss of data. [/p][p][/p][p][i]Release date: July 15th, 2025[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New 3D renderer[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]New rasterizer and pathtracer[/b][/h3][p]This new release gives you access to an advanced [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/interface/3d-view/3d-renderers.html"]3D renderer[/url], featuring a rasterizer mode (to have a real time preview while working on your material) and a path tracer mode (a ray traced mode to get a perfect and accurate render). This new renderer enhances functionality with features such as shadows in rasterizer mode, improves quality and performance, and is engineered to support future technologies like [url="https://materialx.org/"]MaterialX[/url]. It complements the existing OpenGL and Iray renderers in Designer and aligns with the renderers available in Substance 3D Viewer and Substance 3D Sampler, ensuring a uniform experience across the ecosystem.[/p][p]The [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/interface/3d-view.html#scene-toolbar"]3d view toolbar[/url] has been updated to have a quick access to some of the new features available in this renderer:[/p][list][*][p][b]Selection tool:[/b] to select a submesh in the scene. Once a submesh is selected you can focus on it (F) or access to its material properties (right click). [/p][/*][*][p][b]Enable pathtracer:[/b] to quickly switch between pathtracer and rasterizer modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enable shadows:[/b] to enable shadows in the scene, useful to see how your materials behave according to light.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enable ground plane:[/b] to enable or not the ground plane in the scene. [/p][/*][/list][p]In addition, the hotkey to rotate the environment light has changed to match the other Substance apps, so it’s now [i][b]shift-right click[/b][/i] instead of [i][b]ctrl-shift-right click[/b][/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Post effects[/b][/h3][p][url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/interface/3d-view/camera/post-effects.html"]Post effects are back[/url]! They are now available through the Camera menu and they are now developed in house.[/p][list][*][p][b]Bloom:[/b] simulate glare around bright spots like lights and reflections, allowing to better visualize emissive surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tone mapping: [/b]the color range with profiles to get a high-dynamic-range (HDR) effect. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Depth of field:[/b] simulates the focus properties of a camera lens (rasterizer only).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Asset edition in context[/b][/h2][p]When you work on your materials, you may want to [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/working-with-3d-scenes.html"]preview it in the context of a specific 3D scene[/url]. That's why we added the possibility to import and render a full scene, with all its textures, cameras and lights. And cherry on top, if this scene references MaterialX shaders, they will be correctly rendered with the rasterizer![/p][p]Once imported, you can work on your scene by selecting a mesh (with a SHIFT + Click or thanks to the scene browser) and [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/working-with-3d-scenes/overriding-scene-materials.html"]overriding any of its materials[/url]. You may then:[/p][list][*][p]Create or load a graph and apply it on a scene material.[/p][/*][*][p]Make adjustments to an existing material by [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/working-with-3d-scenes/extracting-materials-values-and-textures.html"]extracting its textures[/url] into a new graph.[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally, once your 3d scene is edited, you can [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/working-with-3d-scenes/exporting-scenes.html"]export it[/url] as a new file, or as a new layer of the original file, preventing you to any loss of data (for USD format only).[/p][p]Last but not least, more 3d formats are now supported for both import and export: USD (+ usda, usdc, usdz), STL, PLY and GLTF, in addition to already available formats FBX and OBJ. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Rich tooltips[/b][/h2][p]Rich tooltips have been introduced to better demonstrate the purpose of each node. These tooltips, currently available only for [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/substance-compositing-graphs/nodes-reference-for-substance-compositing-graphs/atomic-nodes.html"]atomic nodes[/url], include visuals to demonstrate the node's effect and provide a direct link to the documentation for detailed information, including the list of parameters, tips, and tricks.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Improve non square support[/b][/h2][p]If you need to work with non square textures, this new option is made for you. In the [url="https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-designer/interface/3d-view/material-properties.html"]material properties[/url] in the 3D view, in the UVs options to control the tiling, you can now set a different value for both axis. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bakers[/b][/h2][p]While the baking interface has seen only minor updates (refer to the detailed list below for more information), the baker library has been fully rebuilt to use GPU-based bakers, resulting in much better performance. Along with the new supported file formats mentioned above, this update represents a substantial advancement for users engaged in baking workflows.[/p][p]Note: if you were using sbsbaker.exe to automate your process, the tool has been renamed to substance3d_baker.exe (use substance3d-baker --help for more information).  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]VFX platform requirements updates[/b][/h2][p]Every year, the [url="https://vfxplatform.com/"]VFX Reference Platform[/url] publishes a list of tools and libraries versions to be used in every software for the VFX industry to minimise incompatibilities between software. As usual, we [i]update all our dependencies[/i] in order to respect all these recommendations.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Video[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6EkXxu-0Q_E"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Release notes[/b][/h2][h3][b]15.0.0[/b][/h3][p][i](Released July 15th, 2025)[/i][/p][h3][b]Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[3D View] Brand new renderer, with rasterizer and pathtracer modes[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Add a selection tool to pick an object in the 3D scene[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Add new "Export scene with layers..." action in the "Scene" menu[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Add new toolbar buttons[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Add the possibility to switch between multiple cameras contained in a USD scene[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Allow to focus on the selected object when pressing 'F' in the viewport[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Allow to generate a Substance Compositing Graph from an existing material[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Allow to send a SBS Comp Graph in the 3D View and assign its unique output to the Environment/Panorama usage[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Clear the current selection by pressing the Escape key[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Display an imported 3D scene with textures[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Distinguish X and Y texture repetition controls[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Enable / Disable shadows[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Enable / Disable ground plane[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] In the "Materials" menu, add the "Remove" only for the Material that have been added manually and are unused[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] In the "Materials" menu, remove the action "Remove All"[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Make exported USDZ files self-contained[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Make the renderer properties persistent when switching the renderer mode[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Preserve the existing material inputs when overriding a Material[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Rearrange Camera properties[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Remove actions "Camera/Save screenshot..." and "Camera/Copy screenshot to clipboard"[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Remove the Menu action "Material/Rebuild all"[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Remove the prefix "Default" of the label of the default camera[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Set the menu action "Reset to default value" as the last one in the material input property hamburger menu[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Shortcut adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Support shadows and translucency in real time mode[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View] Support MaterialX shaders from an imported USD scene[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / OpenGL] Rename the "UV Scale Enabled" parameter to "Enable Physical Size from Graph"[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Post effects] Bloom[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Post effects] Depth of field[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Post effects] Tone mapping[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Scene Browser] Allow to display the Material properties when selecting it in the SceneBrowser[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Scene Browser] Hide the column "Material"[/p][/*][*][p]\[3D View / Scene Browser] Put in bold the USD Primitives that are controlled by a Predefined entity[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Add a contextual menu in the treeview with "Select all"/"Deselect all" actions[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Add an option to control bitangent interpolation[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Add horizontal splitter in GUI[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Add UDIM macro by default in output name when the scene is udim [/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Allow to recompute tangent [/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Allow to rename a baker without breaking links[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Change the default size of the middle panel[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Input texture for UDIM workflow[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Make 2D View maps list order match Bakers render list order[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Make the baking window modal[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Manage tonemapping parameters[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Remove tangent space plugin selection[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Save status "enabled" or "disabled" for Bakers when saving a Preset[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Select material by default in select widget [/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Set default orientation of Normal output texture relative to the preference[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] Set UV tiles to All by default[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] WordSpaceDirection add option FromTexture/FromValue[/p][/*][*][p]\[Bakers] World to tangent: set default input to "from texture"[/p][/*][*][p]\[SBSBaker] Create an option to control the backend order[/p][/*][*][p]\[SBSBaker] Improve use of StringList argument[/p][/*][*][p]\[SBSBaker] Rename "match_source_instance" to "match_mesh_name"[/p][/*][*][p]\[SBSBaker] Rename "Submesh" to "GeomSubset" [/p][/*][*][p]\[SBSBaker] Rename to substance3d_baker[/p][/*][*][p]\[Content] Add 'Hemisphere' shape to generator nodes exposing Quadrant notes.title: New minor update: Designer 14.1.2
notes.content:
We have just released a new minor version (14.1.2). 
Look at the detailled release notes for more information.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] [Graph] Use the default GPU engine to generate thumbnails for the current graph
[*] [Library] Use the default GPU engine to generate thumbnails for the library
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] [Graph] Cannot move connections in some cases in 'Standard' link creation mode
[*] [Content] Artifacts in MLV filter output in a specific case
[*] [Content] Atlas splitter/scatter: only first cell is drawn correctly (macOS + GPU engine only)
[*] [Content] Bevel Smooth: format is absolute 32f
[*] [Content] Fibers 1: visual artefacts when converting to normal map
[*] [Content] RT AO, Shadows, Bent Normal render incorrectly in some cases
[*] [Bakers] Menu items with submenus miss some margin on the right of the text
[*] [MacArm][sbsrender] Wrong CPU engine when GPU engine not found
[*] [Mac/Linux][sbsrender] Wrong default GPU engine
[/list]
